quizName: DMV Practice Test #12 25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: Which lane position makes a motorcyclist easiest to see?
questions.explanation: The center lane position is best because it puts you in the driver's rearview mirror. Be ready to change positions if traffic or road conditions require it.

questions.question: What is the best footwear for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather boots offer the best protection. They should be high and sturdy enough to cover and support your ankles.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, what is true about mirrors?

options.text: The mirrors provide a perfect view.
The mirrors do not show your blind spots.
The mirrors should not be used except when parking.

questions.correctAnswerText: The mirrors do not show your blind spots.
questions.explanation: Motorcycle mirrors have blind spots, just like any vehicle. Always turn your head to check for traffic in your blind spot before changing lanes.

questions.question: How should you brake on a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Use both brakes every time you slow down or stop.

questions.question: If another motorcycle is passing you, where should you ride in your lane?

options.text: Ride in the left portion of the lane.
Ride in the center portion of the lane.
Ride in the right portion of the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride in the center portion of the lane.
questions.explanation: The center of the lane is safest when being passed. Riding on the side nearest the passing vehicle risks a collision. Riding on the far side may make the other driver return to your lane too soon, creating danger.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what formation is best?
questions.explanation: A staggered formation is best for group riding. It keeps riders close together while giving each rider enough space to react safely. Use single-file for curves, turns, or entering and exiting highways.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign has white with red and black markings. It means right turns are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: When it starts to rain, what should you do?

options.text: Ride in the center of the lane.
Ride in the tire tracks left by cars.
Pull to the side of the road until the rain stops.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride in the tire tracks left by cars.
questions.explanation: When it rains, the oily center of the lane becomes slippery and dangerous. Ride in the tire tracks left by cars instead. The left tire track is often safest, but this can change.

questions.question: What is the best way to stay safe while riding a motorcycle?

options.text: Look well ahead of your motorcycle.
Ride at speeds faster than the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look well ahead of your motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Constantly scan the road ahead to spot dangers before you reach them. This helps you react safely to potential hazards.

questions.question: How can you help others see your motorcycle?

options.text: Maintain eye contact with other road users.

questions.explanation: Riding with your headlight on is the best way to help others see you. Always check that your headlight works before you start riding.

questions.question: What should you wear when riding during the day?
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen during the day. Wear reflective clothing so other drivers can see you. Always wear clothing that covers your arms and legs.

questions.question: Where do most motorcycle and car accidents happen?
questions.explanation: Most collisions between motorcycles and cars happen at intersections. Car drivers often fail to give the right-of-way to motorcycles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black letters or symbols. This sign warns you that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: Where should you position your motorcycle in the lane when being passed?
questions.explanation: Stay in the center of your lane when being passed. Moving closer to the passing driver creates danger for both of you.

questions.question: When should you wear reflective clothing?
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen during the day. Wear bright, reflective clothing whenever you ride.

questions.question: What is the legal blood alcohol limit for operating a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Adults 21 and older cannot ride with 0.08 percent blood alcohol or higher. Riders under 21 cannot ride with 0.01 percent or higher. Even below the legal limit, alcohol can make riding unsafe.

questions.question: What type of gloves should you wear when riding?
questions.explanation: Wear full-fingered gloves made of durable material. They improve your grip and protect your hands.

questions.question: When carrying a passenger, what should you NOT do?

options.text: Ride at slower speeds than usual.
Allow more stopping distance than usual.
Tell the passenger to hold onto the back of the bike.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell the passenger to hold onto the back of the bike.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds weight and changes how the motorcycle handles. Ride slower and use longer stopping distances. Your passenger should hold the passenger handgrips or your waist.

questions.question: What color are service signs?
questions.explanation: Blue signs with white letters show where services are located. These include rest areas, gas stations, food, and hospitals.

questions.question: What is the best position to ride in within a lane?

options.text: There is no single best lane position.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is no single best lane position.
questions.explanation: There is no one best position. Good riders change their position as road and traffic conditions change.

questions.question: Which brake on a motorcycle gives the most stopping power?
questions.explanation: The front brake provides about three-quarters of your motorcycle's stopping power. Always use both brakes when you stop.

questions.question: A motorcycle's brake light is _________ a car's brake light.
questions.explanation: Motorcycle brake lights are usually harder to see than car brake lights. Other drivers may not notice when you brake. Stay aware of this danger.

questions.question: A pre-ride inspection:

options.text: Should only be done by a certified mechanic.

questions.explanation: Check your motorcycle before every ride. This quick inspection takes only a few minutes.

questions.question: When riding near a truck:

options.text: If you cannot see the truck's mirrors, the driver cannot see you.
You should not be able to see the truck's mirrors.
You should focus on riding and not worry about the truck's mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you cannot see the truck's mirrors, the driver cannot see you.
questions.explanation: Stay out of blind spots on all vehicles, especially large trucks. If you cannot see the truck's mirrors, the driver cannot see you.

questions.question: You have a better chance of avoiding serious injury in a crash if you wear:
questions.explanation: A helmet is your best protection against injury while riding. A plastic face shield helps protect your face from injury in a crash.
